mcp_tools.name: omnishorts_create_video
mcp_tools.description: Generates and renders a complete 9:16 vertical MP4 Short with voiceover, Foley SFX, BGM ducking, and burned-in ASS karaoke subtitles across any of the 5 modes (cinematic_story, reddit_story, fake_chat, viral_quiz, long_to_shorts).

topic_or_input.description: Topic, script, novel passage, Reddit question, or clip timestamp

mcp_tools.name: omnishorts_clip_long_video
mcp_tools.description: Extracts a high-retention 9:16 vertical Short from a 16:9 widescreen video using Active Speaker Face Tracking or Split-Screen Podcast layout (AutoClip + OpenShorts engine).

mcp_tools.name: omnishorts_lock_character_dna
mcp_tools.description: Registers or updates a character in CharacterVault with persistent DNA prompt, wardrobe tags, deterministic seed, and IP-Adapter weight (ViMax + Toonflow continuity).

mcp_tools.name: omnishorts_export_comfyui_workflow
mcp_tools.description: Exports a low-VRAM ComfyUI node graph JSON with IP-Adapter character consistency locks for local GPU execution (Pixelle-Video bridge).
